delta: When a complaint involves delays or failures in delivering a product or fulfilling an order (e.g., late delivery, missing items), label it as delivery_fulfilment. Label it as service_fault only when the issue stems from poor customer interaction, support, or handling after delivery has occurred.
title: Clarify delivery_fulfilment vs service_fault boundaries
rationale: Reviewers repeatedly re-labelled late-delivery complaints as service_fault; anchoring on the timing/nature of the problem reduces that confusion without over-firing.
based_on: feedback [inaccurate]: kept reading late-delivery complaints as a service-handling issue - tighten the delivery vs service boundary
